title: Marketing automation: the fitnessmarketing trend for 2019 (3/3)

facts.fact: The vendor's blog post 'Marketing automation: fitnessmarketing trend for 2019 (3/3)' was posted on 18 December 2018.
The vendor's Hidden Profits Marketing innovation team shares 3 fitness marketing trends for 2019 that the vendor says cannot be ignored.
facts.quote: they share 3 trends that cannot be ignored in your marketing strategy for 2019

facts.fact: According to the vendor, its LeadConnect automation requires only about 30 seconds of effort from the gym to use, since the system calls the lead automatically once the club picks up the phone.
facts.quote: A 30 second effort for you, with incredible (proven) results for your fitness sales.

facts.fact: The vendor states its fitness marketing services are available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, New Zealand and around the world.
facts.quote: Available in the United States of America, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, New Zealand and around the world.
